_how_to_use: Extra cameras for the dashboard, added by hand. Each camera belongs to one airport (use the ids listed below).
For a volcano camera, use "volcano" (mayon, bulusan, taal, kanlaon, ...) instead of "airport".
url: the camera's own page. It is shown as a link that opens that page, because sites such as SkylineWebcams and EarthCam do not allow their video to be shown inside another website.
youtube: optional. A YouTube video id or link. If the owner allows it, the video plays on the dashboard itself.
source and note are optional. Save the file; it shows on the dashboard at the next update (about 10 minutes).
